title: Static Orthogonal Worm and Wheel Display
description: One newly authored static orthogonal screw-and-toothed-wheel display for the original steam-workshop transmission-appearance direction. A grounded full base carries four whole bored bearing pedestals, two perpendicular horizontal shafts, one complete three-turn thick helical worm flight and one full bored oblique-tooth wheel, plus four fixed shaft stops. The elevated screw axis crosses above the upright wheel with a deliberate minimum20mm envelope display gap; the pair is not claimed to mesh or transmit motion. This is a whole new opposed-axis apparatus, not the old parallel-shaft spur-gear kit with changed tooth counts and not a detached soil-auger flight renamed. All geometry is new and independently editable; three opaque constant PBR materials. One model, zero scenes, metres and horizontal bounds-centred ground origin. Static illustrative display only: no conjugate tooth profile, real worm drive, speed ratio, motion range, bearing function, engineering accuracy, manufacturing, installation, power, load or safety claim. Small fixed collar/flight-to-shaft assembly overlaps are intentional visual joins, not mechanical tolerance proof.
